source: Scraped from public product pages on https://www.caliwheels.com on 2026-11-20 (brand listing pages for Vossen Hybrid Forged, Lexani, Lexani Forged, Forgiato, Fuel, Vossen). The site does not list prices or per-wheel size tables on these pages; diameters_listed only contains sizes stated in the wheel's own product description.
face_processing: Original product renders are 3/4-angle transparent PNGs hosted by iConfigurators for caliwheels.com. Faces were flattened to face-on with an ellipse-to-circle warp (and hub re-centering where it worked) and circular-masked. Design, colors and spoke count are unchanged.

wheels.name: Vossen Hybrid Forged VFS-2
wheels.description: Our new VF Series made with flow forming technology allows us to offer a variety of new widths. Our VFS-2 will be introduced in a 20” and 22” diameter with a width range of 8.5” all the way to 12”. We will be offering three concave design profiles in 20” – flat, mid and deep. These new width options will provide more fitment flexibility and versatility, along with a stronger and lighter wheel.
